steps.instruction: Do not change anything; keep the primary buttons in the standard Left Click / Right Click layout.
Set the physical Right Click control to Left Click. NGENUITY will atomically swap both primary assignments.
Use the physical RIGHT button for UI clicks and set its control back to Right Click. NGENUITY will restore both assignments.
Repeat: set the physical Right Click control to Left Click and let NGENUITY atomically swap the pair.
Use the physical RIGHT button for UI clicks and restore its control to Right Click. Finish in the standard layout.
